title_en: Building Materials Cost Index: Peninsular Malaysia
title_ms: Indeks Kos Bahan Binaan: Semenanjung Malaysia
description_en: Monthly building materials cost index for Peninsular Malaysia, by category of building and region, excluding and including steel bars.
description_ms: Indeks kos bahan binaan bulanan bagi Semenanjung Malaysia, mengikut kategori bangunan dan kawasan, tanpa dan termasuk bar keluli.
methodology_en:
The Building Materials Cost Index (BCI) measures the average rate of change in the prices of 15 selected building materials used in 8 categories of building, and is compiled using the Laspeyres formula. The specifications and weights of the materials for each category of building are set by the Public Works Department (JKR). Prices are collected every month, with around 3,000 price quotations from about 500 outlets where contractors buy their materials. The index is published both excluding and including steel bars, and is the reference for price variation in government building contracts. Peninsular Malaysia is divided into 6 regions: Penang, Kedah & Perlis; Perak; Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, Melaka & Negeri Sembilan; Johor; Pahang; and Kelantan & Terengganu.

Indices before January 2023 were compiled on earlier base periods, each with its own material specifications and weights. To provide a continuous series, they are linked to the January 2023=100 base at the reference month of each later base, so the month-on-month and year-on-year changes within each base period are unchanged. The base periods and the months they cover are:
- July 2008=100: July 2008 to June 2012
- July 2012=100: July 2012 to June 2017
- July 2017=100: July 2017 to December 2022
- January 2023=100: January 2023 onwards

A series that was introduced with a later base starts in that base's first month. Indices including steel bars start in December 2008.
methodology_ms:
Indeks Kos Bahan Binaan (IKB) mengukur kadar perubahan purata harga 15 bahan binaan terpilih yang digunakan dalam 8 kategori bangunan, dan dihasilkan menggunakan formula Laspeyres. Spesifikasi dan pemberat bahan bagi setiap kategori bangunan ditetapkan oleh Jabatan Kerja Raya (JKR). Harga dipungut setiap bulan, dengan kira-kira 3,000 sebut harga daripada lebih kurang 500 outlet tempat kontraktor membeli bahan binaan. Indeks ini diterbitkan tanpa dan termasuk bar keluli, dan menjadi rujukan bagi perubahan harga dalam kontrak kerja bangunan kerajaan. Semenanjung Malaysia dibahagikan kepada 6 kawasan: Pulau Pinang, Kedah & Perlis; Perak; Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, Melaka & Negeri Sembilan; Johor; Pahang; serta Kelantan & Terengganu.

Indeks sebelum Januari 2023 dihasilkan berdasarkan tempoh asas yang terdahulu, setiap satunya dengan spesifikasi bahan dan pemberat tersendiri. Bagi menghasilkan siri yang berterusan, indeks tersebut dirantaikan kepada asas Januari 2023=100 pada bulan rujukan bagi setiap asas berikutnya, maka perubahan bulan ke bulan dan tahun ke tahun dalam setiap tempoh asas kekal tidak berubah. Tempoh asas dan bulan yang diliputi adalah seperti berikut:
- Julai 2008=100: Julai 2008 hingga Jun 2012
- Julai 2012=100: Julai 2012 hingga Jun 2017
- Julai 2017=100: Julai 2017 hingga Disember 2022
- Januari 2023=100: Januari 2023 dan seterusnya

Siri yang diperkenalkan dengan asas yang kemudian bermula pada bulan pertama asas tersebut. Indeks termasuk bar keluli bermula pada Disember 2008.
caveat_en: Data for the most recent 12 months may be revised in subsequent releases.
caveat_ms: Data bagi 12 bulan terkini mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan berikutnya.
publication_en: [Building Materials Cost Index, Sep 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/bc_2026-09), the latest edition of the monthly building materials cost statistics published by DOSM.
publication_ms: [Indeks Kos Bahan Binaan, Sep 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/bc_2026-09), edisi terkini bagi statistik kos bahan binaan bulanan yang diterbitkan oleh DOSM.
